aboutMe:
Accomplished Senior Solutions Architect with over 8 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering high-impact software solutions across diverse industries. Expertise in leading cross-functional teams to architect scalable, secure, and innovative systems, with a strong focus on cloud technologies, blockchain, AI, and real-time platforms. Adept at translating business requirements into actionable technical strategies and overseeing the full product lifecycle, from concept to implementation.

Recognized for my ability to manage complex projects and mentor teams towards successful, high-quality deliveries. My approach to solution design is centered around clarity, precision, and a customer-first mindset, ensuring that solutions are not only technically sound but also aligned with user and business needs. Clients value my transparent communication, technical acumen, and ability to deliver tailored solutions that drive operational excellence.

Known for crafting intuitive and user-centric UI designs that have contributed significantly to customer acquisition and retention. I continuously fine-tune and optimize interfaces to deliver seamless, high-performing experiences, ensuring the best possible user journey.

Dedicated to fostering a collaborative environment, I prioritize delivering results while balancing the needs of both stakeholders and development teams. Proven track record in building long-term relationships and consistently achieving organizational goals through strategic planning, hands-on leadership, and continuous innovation.

career.title: Product Solutions Architect | Lead Software Engineer
responsibilities: Architected and led the end-to-end development of a comprehensive online dispute resolution platform, integrating negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and court judgment workflows into a single, user-friendly interface.

Designed and implemented a highly configurable workflow engine, reducing developer dependency for flow management and enabling rapid customization for various dispute types through a drag-and-drop interface and configurable.
Developed a custom appointment scheduler that optimizes meeting times by analysing the availability of all involved parties.
Integrated secure in-app payments using Stripe Payment Intents and designed a system for complex refund logic, streamlining financial transactions within the platform.

Architected and implemented a scalable microservices architecture on Azure (App Services, Function Apps, Container Apps), enhancing system maintainability, portability, and supporting teams with diverse skill sets.

Designed and implemented the Azure infrastructure, including App Gateway routing, API Management for security and policy enforcement, Service Bus for queuing, Redis Cache for API requests, SignalR for real-time updates, and a multi-tenant Azure Cosmos DB (MongoDB API) with complex querying, sharding, and indexing.

Led the testing team and architected a configurable testing framework using TestIM, significantly increasing testing efficiency and enabling comprehensive system testing across different workflows without requiring test script recreation.

Spearheaded client engagement from initial requirements gathering to UAT, ensuring clear communication, managing expectations, and leading the team through the development lifecycle (Jira, Agile methodologies).
Developed AI-powered features including video conference summarization (Azure Open AI GPT4) and an AI evidence (Azure AI Foundry), enhancing the platform's capabilities for mediators and arbitrators.
Managed the transition from Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions for streamlined and automated CI/CD deployments.
Recognized statewide for providing a user-friendly, customizable, all-in-one ODR solution that significantly improves access to justice.

projects.title: CMS - Case Management System
projects.description: Architected and managed the infrastructure for a case management system used by over 30 courts, handling 10,000+ payment transactions (online and in-person).
projects.technologies: Dynamics APIs, App Gateway, Storage Account, Stripe, Azure Service Bus, NX, Github Actions, Azure Function Apps, App Services, Azure API Management,Service Bus
items: Architected the integration of all components and microservices, making all services available through a single endpoint via App Gateway, and ensured zero downtime.
Administered the infrastructure and DevOps pipelines, ensuring high availability, security, and automated deployments across all environments.

Secured APIs through Azure API Management (APIM), integrating multiple APIs hosted across Function Apps, App Services, Azure Dynamics, Service Bus queues, and webhooks, ensuring centralized security, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

Designed and implemented reusable microservices for core functionalities such as payments, dynamic forms, and notifications, enabling rapid onboarding of new courts and reducing duplication of effort across projects.
Implemented secure online payment processing using Stripe, managing double-spending risks and integrating with a webhook for payment processing via a service bus queue.
Led the successful onboarding of the government entity with Stripe, facilitating secure fund transfers to connect accounts and managing payouts and disputes.
Integrated cloud-connected Wisepos terminals for in-person payments, linking each terminal to specific courts based on organizational units.
Utilized a mono-repo structure with NX for improved code management and implemented server-side rendering for enhanced performance.

projects.title: Supply Chain Management DAPP
projects.description: Founded and architected an award-winning, end-to-end supply chain management suit on Hyperledger Fabric, leveraging AI for productivity and fraud tracking.
projects.technologies: Hyperledger Fabric (1.x, 2.x, CouchDB, Kafka, Raft, Private Data, HSM Wallets), Angular, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, VMWare, Node.js, Mobile Development (Android/iOS), QR Scanning, GPS Tracking, AI
items: Designed and developed a multi-organization blockchain network with segregated data (private data) and implemented robust security measures using HSM wallets and user identity roles.

Built and deployed multiple user interfaces including an Angular web app for manufacturers, distributors, and retailers, mobile apps for POS, item verification (QR scan), and courier tracking (automated QR scanning with GPS).

Managed and administered the Hyperledger Fabric network, including deploying new resources, creating organizations, channel updates, upgrading the blockchain from 1.x to 2.x, migrating to Raft ordering, and handling certificate renewals and data migration.
Deployed and managed the infrastructure on VMWare hosts using Docker Swarm and Kubernetes.

items: Implemented video analysis capabilities using Azure Video Indexer for facial recognition and transcription, and integrated edge and cloud-based suspicious object detection.
Built a real-time application using Socket.io for on-site robot control, map tracking, and voice communication.
Integrated Okta for secure authentication and implemented role-based access control.

Managed IBM Blockchain administration and executed version upgrades.
